summary.headline: Aquarius: Qualities and Climes
summary.text: Astrological description of Aquarius, including its gender, form, qualities, effects on those born under it, associated stars and constellations, ruling gods, and geographical climes from Egypt and the Red Sea to the Ammonian land. The text also identifies neighboring constellations and regions, including Andromeda, the Horse, the Fishes, Hydra, the Raven, Eridanus, the Great Fish, the Bird, the Arrow, and Cynosura.
